note: Secluded Chippewa National Forest campground on Mabel Lake with a sandy beach, about 26 miles east of Walker off Highway 200; the North Country Trail and the Boy River are nearby. Sites sit in the woods back from the shore. Bears are active: food must be stored in hard-sided campers or vehicles. --Claude
summary: rec.gov API + RIDB catalog + Chippewa NF page read: $14 flat, 22 sites (rec.gov 21: 10 reservable / 11 FCFS, 4-day cutoff, 6-month window), non-electric, vault toilets, season 05-28 to 09-20 (2027). Not waterfront confirmed (wooded, ~55-70 m). Phone none -> 218-547-1044. Drinking-water conflict flagged (FS 'not available' vs rec.gov 'hand pump'); stored potable_water false left.

Plotting the rec.gov site points on imagery, the shore-side sites (13 at 47.05069,-94.07220; 14 at 47.05037,-94.07244; 16 at 47.04993,-94.07259; 18 at 47.04957,-94.07283; 19 at 47.04931,-94.07303) are ~55-70 m from the beach through continuous woods; no site is on open ground to the water and no view could be confirmed under the canopy.
Status: FS page shows 'Site Temporarily Closed' / 'Closed for the Season' (seasonal closure, not a long-term one).
Season: 2027 per the FS. The rec.gov rate seasons for 2026 ran May 22 to Sept 21 (rate seasons are not a campground season; not written).
Sites: FS 22 vs rec.gov 21 (the stored note's '1 host' accounts for the difference). Site 9 driveway 37 ft, the shortest; all fit a 23-ft rig.
Discount: rec.gov rule 'tribalDiscount' for the Leech Lake Band of Ojibwe (not written).
Pin 47.04930,-94.07140 is ~70 m south-east of the site centroid (~47.0499,-94.0718), inside the loop. OK.
